This is a much lower rate than the median Psychology paper (median shown in black); relative to other words, papers with "spaced" are in the bottom 0th percentile of fragile p-value percentages (lower = better). Note, strong/weak p-values highly predict replicability.
statement1: As of 2020-2024, papers containing "spaced" tend to be published in lower impact factor journals (19th percentile among all words) and tend to be cited less (2nd percentile word).
